summary: Tower listed as gone. The FFLA index says Newton County, but the TSHA and a 2011 Texas tower list place it in Orange County. No history of the tower found.

facts.status_note: FFLA index marks Mauriceville as Gone. Sources give no removal date or cause.

evidence.supports: Handbook places Mauriceville at the junction of State highways 12 and 62 in north central Orange County
evidence.quote: Mauriceville, also known as Maurice, is at the junction of State highways 12 and 62, seventeen miles northeast of Beaumont in north central Orange County.

evidence.supports: Handbook: community established in the wake of two railroads, Texarkana and Fort Smith (1898) and Orange and Northwestern (1902)
evidence.quote: It was established in the wake of the construction of two railroads: the Texarkana and Fort Smith (in 1898) and the Orange and Northwestern (1902).

evidence.supports: Index lists Mauriceville as a Tower marked Gone, with county Newton
Texas tower list places the Mauriceville tower in Orange County at 30.24517, -93.82062
Texas tower list was last revised in January 2011

corrections.why: The Handbook of Texas places Mauriceville in north central Orange County. The 2011 Texas tower list gives Orange County for the tower's coordinates, which are the same as the FFLA entry's coordinates.

sources.title: Mauriceville, TX
sources.publisher: Texas State Historical Association, Handbook of Texas Online

notes_for_editor: Three sources, none describing the tower itself. The brief's county Newton is contradicted by the TSHA handbook and by the tower list, so a county correction is proposed; the FFLA index is the only source for Newton. Search hits for 'Mauriceville tower' returned railroad interlocking Tower 125 (txrrhistory.com and abandonedrails.com), which is not a fire lookout and is excluded. Two WebSearch calls and one Portal to Texas History search (no results) found no fire-tower history. The Forest Lookouts site has no Mauriceville page. The story is about 130 words and says no more than the sources do. Access, visit and site-today are not recorded because no source describes them.
